title.en: "Akage no Yakutatazu" to Kubi ni natta Maryokunashi no Majo desu ga, "Yakusou no Chishiki ga Hanpanai!" to Ouritsu Kenkyuujo ni Soku Saiyou Saremashita.

altTitles.ja: 「赤毛の役立たず」とクビになった魔力なしの魔女ですが、「薬草の知識がハンパない！」と王立研究所に即採用されました。

description.en:
"Lugina, you're fired starting today!" With those harsh words, Lugina, the red-haired girl, was kicked out of her job as a witch in the herbal workshop — simply because she had no magical power. Even her skill in potion-making was mocked by everyone around her. In just a moment, Lugina lost her job, her home, and her future...

Wandering aimlessly, she happens to meet a strange and eccentric nobleman named Eric, who becomes fascinated by her vast knowledge of medicinal herbs. Impressed, he tells her, "Your knowledge of herbs is incredible! Would you like to work with me at the Royal Institute I founded?" Lugina, who had never been praised by anyone in her life, is stunned — but shyly and curiously accepts his offer.

However, Eric's offer wasn't just about a job... As time passes, this unusual nobleman starts to draw closer to her, surrounding her with a special kind of care unlike anything she's ever known.
description.ja: 「ルジェナ・レジェク。今日でお前はクビだ！」「みんな気を遣ってたんですよ。魔力がない魔女なのに、調剤まで下手くそなんて」薬草工房長の代替わりにより、仕事と住む場所を突然失ったルジェナ。しかし、偶然知り合った貴族のエーリクは前のめりに提案する。「ルジェナ、君の薬草の知識、すごいよ！私の作った王立研究所で働いてくれないか？」それまで自分の知識を褒められたことなどないルジェナは、信じられない思いでそれを承諾する。しかし、エーリクの提案はそれだけではなくて――!?
